versions.content: destinationUriNestingContract is set to vertexOf- TargetContainer When the destinationUriNestingContract is set to ver- texOfTargetContainer the attributes container s, parameter s and refer- ence s qualify elements of the target container which can be defined in arbitrary nested subContainer structure. In this case the according EcucContainerDef or any sub- Container shall have at least the defined subContainers, references and parameters with the given attributes (e.g shortName, range and multiplicity).
